title: Jesse’s space
name: Jesse McBride
description: Jesse McBride. Software, music, and small worlds. A personal website from Orlando.
about: I’m a staff software engineer at Apple, with a background in embedded security. I like turning complicated systems into something people can understand and use.

Before Apple, I built web applications and education tools at the University of Central Florida, where I led development of [CanvasAPI](https://github.com/ucfopen/canvasapi). I studied information technology at UCF and earned an MBA at Rollins.
Outside work: yoga, learning Spanish, Tolkien, space, and games with a strong sense of place. I make my own things under APT404.

now.gameNote: Song of the Elves and Morytania Hard complete. Smolcano appreciation, always.

projects.title: Tomato Knight
projects.summary: Focus sessions restore a little world called Everpatch: gardens, villages, and a map to explore with a small knight.
body: I wanted a focus timer with a world worth returning to. In Tomato Knight, real focus sessions restore Everpatch: gardens, villages, a map to uncover, and a small knight with things to do.
The important bit: doing a little real work should feel like making a little progress in the world.

projects.title: Say What
projects.summary: A game about the people in the room. Answer questions, vote on superlatives, and see what your friends say.
body: A game built around the people in the room. Answer questions, vote on who fits a superlative, and find out how your friends see each other. I like that the group brings most of the game with them.

projects.title: Tala
projects.summary: A yoga companion I’m building for choosing a flow and getting on with the practice.
body: I wanted a yoga companion that feels calm and easy to use. Tala is a place to choose a flow, settle into a rhythm, and get on with the practice.

projects.title: CanvasAPI
projects.summary: A Python toolkit for the Canvas learning platform.
body: I led development of CanvasAPI at UCF. These days, it has a life of its own: integrations, research tools, and projects built by people around the world.
